versions.changelog: 🔒 安全优化版本：完善凭证管理说明、加密机制说明、依赖声明、隐私保护政策和安全最佳实践，修复元数据依赖不一致问题

comments-monitor-reply 1.0.0

- Initial release with multi-platform comment monitoring and intelligent auto-reply for Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Wechat Channels, Wechat MP, Weibo, Bilibili, and Kuaishou
- Real-time sentiment analysis and personalized reply generation with customizable templates
- Negative sentiment alerting with configurable escalation and trend analysis
- Supports multi-account management, whitelist/blacklist, manual review mode, and reply history tracking
- Provides CLI commands for setup, monitoring, template management, alerting, and report generation
